items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: Every W2 AC mapped to code and a test; documented deviations (lead form in dialog, row click opens dialog) flagged.

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: Unknown item kind throws (as before); lead answer errors still surfaced; filter falls back to all when empty.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: All text rendered as React text nodes; markdown only for the same kinds through MarkdownText; hostile-text unit + real-browser probes; Answer button only navigates (no-writepath fence extended).

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: Model, filter, dialog, hostile text, touch layout covered; old card tests re-targeted rather than deleted.

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: Per-poll model recompute is O(items), negligible; no new polling or effects beyond filter reset.

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: New files under 300 lines; dead card/shell/phaseMeta removed; InboxPage.test stays under its baseline.

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: No serialized format changed (client presentation only); probes: untrusted text to DOM round trip in jsdom and real Chromium.
